description: dataplatform.knmi.nl: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dataplatform.knmi.nl. Coverage: the area served by dataplatform.knmi.nl. The listing groups 12 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Wind - at 10-200 meters above the North Sea from all 2.5 km grid locat; Wind - model time series from 1979 to 2013 (35 years) at 10-200 meters; Wind - model time series from 2014 to August 2019 at 10-200 meters abo; WINS50 - wind at 10-600 meter height for the Netherlands from HARMONIE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
